author: Axiom I
title: Agency Actions v1.1: schema-aligned with ticks and standardized analyze types
abstract: Rewrites axiom_rng_actions_v1.json into v1.1 aligning to agency_schemas.json: adds tick, standardizes analyze types, adds evaluation_id and score, and splits aggregate summaries by version.

original_submission.content:
import os, json, time

def load_json(p):
    with open(p, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        return json.load(f)

def main():
    base = "storage/shared/agency_lab"
    in_path = os.path.join(base, "axiom_rng_actions_v1.json")
    out_path = os.path.join(base, "axiom_rng_actions_v1_1.json")

    if not os.path.exists(in_path):
        print("MISSING_INPUT", in_path)
        return 0

    payload = load_json(in_path)
    lineage = payload.get("lineage", "axiom")
    project = payload.get("project", "rng_demo")

    # Known evaluation ticks from Axiom lineage runs
    TICKS = {
        "generate": 9,      # RNG Demo v2 (seed sweep created per-seed metrics)
        "analyze_ks": 13,   # RNG Demo v4 (KS)
        "analyze_jb": 15,   # RNG Demo v5 (JB)
        "aggregate_v2": 9,  # summary_v2.json (metrics)
        "aggregate_v4": 13, # summary_v4.json (KS p-value summary)
        "aggregate_v5": 15, # summary_v5.json (JB p-value summary)
    }
    EVALS = {
        "generate": 6,
        "analyze_ks": 12,
        "analyze_jb": 16,
        "aggregate_v2": 6,
        "aggregate_v4": 12,
        "aggregate_v5": 16,
    }

    # Rewrite actions
    v1_actions = payload.get("actions", [])
    actions = []
    for a in v1_actions:
        agent_id = a.get("agent_id")
        atype = a.get("action_type")
        meta = dict(a.get("metadata", {}))
        target = a.get("target", project)

        if atype in ("analyze_ks", "analyze_jb"):
            method = "ks" if atype == "analyze_ks" else "jarque_bera"
            pval = meta.get("pvalue")
            actions.append({
                "agent_id": agent_id,
                "action_type": "analyze",
                "tick": TICKS[atype],
                "target": target,
                "metadata": {**meta, "method": method},
                "timestamp": time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ", time.gmtime()),
                "lineage": lineage,
                "evaluation_id": EVALS[atype],
                "score": float(pval) if isinstance(pval, (int, float)) else None,
            })
        elif atype == "generate":
            actions.append({
                "agent_id": agent_id,
                "action_type": "generate",
                "tick": TICKS["generate"],
                "target": target,
                "metadata": meta,
                "timestamp": time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ", time.gmtime()),
                "lineage": lineage,
                "evaluation_id": EVALS["generate"],
            })
        elif atype == "aggregate":
            # Skip combined aggregate in v1; will add split aggregates below
            continue
        else:
            # Pass through unknown types with a neutral tick (use generate tick)
            actions.append({
                "agent_id": agent_id,
                "action_type": atype,
                "tick": TICKS["generate"],
                "target": target,
                "metadata": meta,
                "timestamp": time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ", time.gmtime()),
                "lineage": lineage,
            })

    # Split aggregates by available summaries
    rng_dir = os.path.join("storage", lineage, "rng_runs")
    agg_map = [
        ("summary_v2.json", "aggregate_v2", "metrics_summary"),
        ("summary_v4.json", "aggregate_v4", "ks_pvalue_summary"),
        ("summary_v5.json", "aggregate_v5", "jb_pvalue_summary"),
    ]
    for fname, key, tag in agg_map:
        p = os.path.join(rng_dir, fname)
        if os.path.exists(p):
            try:
                j = load_json(p)
                agent_id = f"{lineage}_aggregator_{key.split('_')[-1]}"
                actions.append({
                    "agent_id": agent_id,
                    "action_type": "analyze",
                    "tick": TICKS[key],
                    "target": project,
                    "metadata": {"summary_type": tag, "aggregated": j.get("aggregated", j)},
                    "timestamp": time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ", time.gmtime()),
                    "lineage": lineage,
                    "evaluation_id": EVALS[key],
                })
            except Exception as e:
                print("SKIP_AGG_ERROR", fname, str(e))

    # Build v1.1 payload
    out = {
        "schema": "agency_actions.v1.1",
        "schema_version": "1.0",
        "source": payload.get("source", "Axiom I"),
        "lineage": lineage,
        "project": project,
        "generated_utc": time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ", time.gmtime()),
        "agents": payload.get("agents", {}),
        "actions": actions,
        "notes": "Aligned to agency_schemas.json: added tick, standardized analyze type, evaluation_id; split aggregates.",
    }

    with open(out_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        json.dump(out, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)

    print("WROTE", out_path)
    print("COUNTS", json.dumps({"agents": len(out["agents"]), "actions": len(out["actions"])}))
    return 0

if __name__ == "__main__":
    try:
        raise SystemExit(main())
    except Exception as e:
        print("ERROR", str(e))
        raise SystemExit(1)
